description: A new link for the owner to claim this draft venue (the previous link stops working). The owner opens it, confirms with a code sent to their email and accepts the terms; then the booking pages open to customers. Until then the venue takes no members or bookings and sends no emails, and it is deleted automatically on its expiry date. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.
